dossiers.catalyst_stack: Noble added about $565 million of contract value on 2026-04-26, including a Petrobras extension of Noble Courage through December 2030, then roughly $200 million more on 2026-07-27 as backlog stood at $6.8 billion. Weatherford’s 2026-05-05 MPD alliance, Jeff Miller’s 2026-05-21 board appointment, and Citi/Susquehanna/Fearnley PT or rating actions through 2026-07-29 were secondary positives. The break was 2026-07-27: a $37 million Q2 loss, $43 million of Brazil idle costs on Faye Kozack and Courage, FY2026 EBITDA cut to $850–$925 million, and a $42 million Ocean Apex scrap impairment, followed by a 9.07% drop on 2026-07-28 and Barclays cutting its PT to $53 on 2026-07-30. Middle East tension and higher oil lifted offshore drillers, including Noble, on 2026-09-25, but that bounce does not reverse the H2 guidance reset.
dossiers.key_assumption: The Brazil suspensions are a contained 2026 utilization hit already inside the lowered $850–$925 million EBITDA guide, not lasting Petrobras downtime or a franchise safety issue.

dossiers.catalyst_stack: From April 3 through August 20, 2026, Transocean stacked major floater awards—about $1 billion of Vår Energi/Petrobras backlog, a 1,156-day Petrobras Corcovado extension, a $1 billion-plus Equinor package, and a ~$300 million ONGC letter of award—lifting reported backlog toward $6.7 billion. Q2 results on August 5 beat on non-GAAP EPS ($0.03) and revenue ($966 million) with $170 million of net income and $212 million of free cash flow, after a May 4 Q1 print that beat on revenue but missed adjusted EPS at -$0.03 versus $0.07 consensus. The Valaris path is the swing factor: a DOJ second request on May 4 and a mid-August report that compliance was still uncertified were followed on September 21 by a deal-spread squeeze on talk the $5.8 billion all-stock deal clears early with no divestitures. Offsets are the May 22 authority to issue up to 240.8 million additional shares (100 million into treasury) and Barclays cutting its target to $7 from $8 on August 12 while staying Overweight.
dossiers.key_assumption: DOJ clears the Valaris purchase without remedies and the $6.7B-plus backlog converts at current dayrates without a utilization or oil-price shock.

dossiers.catalyst_stack: On 16 Jul 2026 Baker Hughes closed Chart Industries after 10 Jul 2026 conditional EU antitrust clearance, adding a third segment and targeting $325 million of annualized cost synergies. Operations stayed ahead of the Street with the 23 Apr 2026 Q1 and 27 Jul 2026 Q2 beats (Q2 adjusted EPS $0.64, record $10.501 billion orders) and a 9 Sep 2026 FY2026 guide raise to $28.5-$30.3 billion revenue and $4.875-$5.475 billion adjusted EBITDA to include Chart. Commercial follow-through included 26 May-24 Jun 2026 U.S. geothermal partnerships (Helmerich & Payne; Mantle Reach up to 500 MW), the 11 Aug 2026 Kuwait Oil Company Ahmadi Innovation Valley award, 13 Sep 2026 Venture Global LNG orders, and the 13 Apr 2026 $1.45 billion Waygate sale to Hexagon. The offset is 15-22 Jun 2026 Rule 10b5-1 selling by the CFO and CEO plus scattered PT cuts (Barclays 16 Jul, Wall Street Zen 5 Aug, UBS 10 Sep) against a still-higher $72.27 mean target and later raises (RBC $76 on 25 Aug).
dossiers.key_assumption: Chart’s $325 million synergy target is executable, the September FY2026 raise is not just deal math with no organic IET/OFSE backing, and June C-suite 10b5-1 sales are planned liquidity rather than a cycle top.

dossiers.catalyst_stack: On 2026-04-01 Kodiak closed Distributed Power Solutions, adding about 395 MW and standing up Kodiak Power Solutions. Record Q1/Q2 2026 adjusted EBITDA (2026-05-11 and 2026-08-06) came with guidance lifts to $830–$860 million, partly funded by the 2026-05-15 equity close that raised about $836 million but diluted the share count. On 2026-07-08 Baker Hughes agreed to supply turbines and generators for an initial ~1 GW by 2030 (framework to 1.8 GW), and on 2026-09-25 Kodiak signed a six-year 76 MW West Texas data-center power contract. That operating stack is tempered by the 2026-05-14 priced dilution, a 2026-08-10 Jefferies target cut to $69, and CEO sales around 2026-08-19 and 2026-09-01 while the stock sits at $53.30 versus an $82.38 average target.
dossiers.key_assumption: DPS integration and Baker Hughes deliveries convert the power backlog into the raised 2026 EBITDA range without another equity raise, and the 76 MW data-center contract is incremental contracted cash flow.
